showcase.title: AI Background Remover
showcase.subtitle: Isolate subjects from their background instantly using state-of-the-art AI that runs 100% locally on your device.

tips.quantized: Select the **Quantized** variant to save RAM and prevent crashes on lower-end machines.
tips.fp16: The **FP16** variant typically offers the **fastest processing speed** if your machine has enough RAM.
tips.unload: Enable 'Auto-unload Model' to free up browser memory immediately after each task.
tips.refinement: Use the 'Edge Refinement' slider to fine-tune how subjects blend with new backgrounds.
tips.batch: You can drag and drop multiple images at once to start a batch process.
tips.hover: Hover over the variant selection to see detailed technical differences.

faqs.q1: What kinds of images are best for this tool?
faqs.a1: It works best for photos with a clear subject in the foreground, such as portraits, product shots, pets, or objects with well-defined edges.
faqs.a2: Yes, AI processing is resource-intensive. A mid-to-high-end machine with a dedicated GPU and at least 6GB of RAM is recommended for the best experience. On lower-end devices, use *Quantized* variants.
faqs.q3: Does it need an internet connection?
faqs.a3: Only for the initial download of the AI models. Once cached in your browser, the tool works 100% offline.
faqs.q4: Why is the first processing slower?
faqs.a4: The first run requires initializing the AI engine and loading the model from the local cache into memory, which can take a few seconds depending on your hardware.
faqs.a5: You can export your processed images as **PNG** (with transparency), **WebP**, **AVIF**, **JXL**, or **JPG** (on a solid background).

downloadDialog.title: Download AI Model
downloadDialog.privacyDesc: This model runs locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device. Imify provides the interface to run these models but is not the distributor.
downloadDialog.internetDesc: A stable internet connection is required for the initial download. Once cached, the model will be available for offline use.
